two friends - one journey - no limits
31512: In early 19th century New England, an unscrupulous woman uses her beauty and wits to seduce, deceive and control the men around her.
The book that was talked of in a Whisper!
31768: In the late 1980s, Pat Tate journeys from peddling pills in Marbella to his time in prison, where he solidifies his power before his release to reclaim his turf.

WHERE ADVENTURE ENDS... AND HELL BEGINS!
32280: A man is forced to completely change his habits when he decides to move from the country to the city.
32536: A fresh face comes to Hollywood to act in movies but only the gay porn studios are eager to provide him with work.
All he wanted was a little adulation.

AN ADVENTURE THAT AVALANCHES FROM THE BULLET-PROOF ROOF OF THE ROCKIES TO THE FIERY DESERT FLOOR!
33304: Two genius brothers grow up and grow apart as one becomes a successful surgeon and the other pursues a drug-fueled high life.
33560: A barkeeper saves a yakuza boss' life and thus makes his way up in the organization. However, his fear of nothing soon causes problems.

34328: A mute noblewoman's vampiric heritage compels her to drain the life force from all of her lovers.

34840: A group of teenagers encounter vampires in a remote outpost.
Something to Sink Your Teeth Into.

Shriya finds it a challenge, especially when she meets men like Siddarth who think marriage is a recipe for disaster, and babies should be banned. 35352: Four friends get together for a nostalgic evening of fun and games after a decade of absence, which takes a dark turn.
One game. One rule. Don't lie... or you die.

Rock Slag / Green Goose / Triple X (voice)
36120: A newly paralyzed DJ gets more than he bargained for when he seeks out the world of faith healing.

Meet Carys. She's a mourning person...

37144: An accident survivor wakes from a coma and confronts old, uncomfortable memories.

An unexpected rival shows up and he gets jealous
37656: Leon falls in love with a nurse and obsessively tries to get close to her.

Glory, W.Va., 1935. It wasn't exactly a parade. It wasn't a time for celebration. It was a time to run for your life.
38168: A man is framed for murder by his drug-dealing best friend who covets his girlfriend, leading to eight years in jail and a vow of revenge upon release.

For The Thrill of The Kill
38936: After a vampire leaves his native Balkans, he murders a Czech artist, assumes his identity, and moves in with the dead man's American cousins.
The most terrifying name in the history of the world now gives you the most horrifying thrill in the history of motion pictures!

39704: An adventurous woman with a secret from her husband insists they go for a romantic camping trip in a remote wood to reconnect and share some quality time. Trapped inside their tent, the couple is forced to help one of the injured hunters and together they plan their escape. Is there really something supernatural hidden in the forest?  Or is it just their imaginations running riot. Soon they must determine if the real threat is inside or outside their enclosure
39960: After inadvertently killing his girlfriend, a man flees Macau for Thailand in an attempt to cope with his guilt, and avoid possible arrest. But the relocation doesn't prevent his problems from following him, as his new friends could be potential enemies.

An action movie about daily life. Feel the speed. Feel the love.
40984: The Great New Wonderful weaves five stories against the backdrop of an anxious and uncertain post-9-11 New York City.
41240: One evening, when they come home, Mr. and Mrs. Prioux are astounded to find that a certain Patrick has moved into their place. This strange young man has returned home to his parents in order to introduce his wife.
41496: The year is 2015 and overpopulation and famine have plunged our planet into chaos and one desperate survivor finds himself being hunted and pursued by hordes of rage-crazed zombies.
41752: The story of a young man who loves crime fiction books, and the daugher of a mafia leader.

42520: When a wife and mother of two finds out her husband has an affair, she tries to make his life a living hell. The sequel to Dutch move hit Schatjes!
42776: A Louisiana con man enters his steamboat into a winner-take-all race with a rival while trying to find a witness to free his nephew, about to be hanged for murder.

Who says you're only young once?
43288: At a strict girls school, a mysterious fire blazes out of control. Now everyone's questioning whether it was an accident — or arson.
43544: Four balloonists and their dog are stranded on a remote island with a woman believed to be a descendant of Frankenstein, who is conducting experiments on lost sailors.
43800: A dedicated NIA officer is torn between love for his family and his duty. On the brink of sacrificing his career for his family, he stumbles upon a plot with international ramifications. Does he stick to his decision to quit or will the call of duty prove too strong for him?
44056: Documentary on director Kim Ki-Duk looking back at his film career.

When his daughter is kidnapped by the mysterious menace he's accidentally messed with, Elvis has 24 hours to come up with $25K - cash only.

She Had To Find Her Past To Embrace Her Future.

And suddenly, Nina realizes, her life is becoming a novel!

Completely traumatized, Eliseo is taken to a mental hospital where he can find escape only through music.

The catch of the day is fresh comedy.

Now they will team up to destroy the evil clan.
Death was his way of life!
46872: In post-Katrina New Orleans, a disgraced detective encounters the ghost of a murdered woman who wants to help him identify her killer.
In the city of ghosts, one woman wants the police to find her killer.

They Trailed Him...Tailed Him...Tried to Nail Him...NO WAY!!!
47384: During an eviction procedure in a troubled area of Madrid, police officer Dani makes a shocking discovery.

A gay party is interrupted by murder and the world's most costly jewel stolen!

A lost world!! Ruled by the largest man eating monster of all!!

WHERE BLACK MAGIC EXPLODES INTO MURDER!

The Most Celebrated Love Adventure of All...From the Greatest Book of All!

50968: Braulio after his misadventures in Berlin, moves to Hong Kong along with Rafa and Hakan in search of new opportunities. However, it is not easy to succeed in a land where language, culture and customs are very different from Europe.

Three strangers. One city. No way out.
